text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon sings her heart out until the very end, never letting go of the audience's attention. Light Hello feels optimistic about the feedback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Agnes Tachyon brings Silence Suzuka to us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, concerts might hold the answer to a question Suzuka's been grappling with. Whatever the case, we have new supporters!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If we keep up the performances, I'm sure our team will grow even bigger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mihono Bourbon seems to have felt something watching the concert as well.
